ideas.pitch: An autonomous onboard vision-guided payload release system utilizing computer vision on a lightweight companion computer to detect landing targets and drop emergency medical supplies within a 10cm radius.
ideas.title: AeroDrop Precision Payload Drop System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Round 2 mission tasks like payload drop and navigation, which carry heavy weight during live flight judging.

ideas.pitch: A robust flight checklist and real-time black box telemetry logger that verifies sensor calibration, battery health, and geofence boundaries before allowing motor arming.
ideas.title: UAV Pre-Flight Airworthiness Telemetry Logger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Crucial for passing Round 1 technical and safety inspections while impressing judges with strict adherence to safety protocols.

ideas.pitch: A real-time aerial mapping pipeline that stitches onboard camera feeds into a local grid map while executing obstacle avoidance heuristics within restricted flight zones.
ideas.title: Autonomous Obstacle-Aware Mapping Drone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced autonomous navigation with the documentation and viva round requirements by generating comprehensive mission reports automatically.

ideas.pitch: An independent hardware fail-safe module utilizing GPS and an RF transceiver to instantly cut motor power if the UAV drifts outside the designated flight zone or exceeds altitude limits.
ideas.title: GeoFence Enforcer and Emergency Killswitch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses strict safety marshal regulations and prevents immediate disqualification during live flight rounds.

ideas.pitch: An automated log parser and visualization tool that ingests flight logs post-flight to generate compliance reports, flight path error metrics, and viva presentation summaries.
ideas.title: UAV Mission Debrief and Log Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Saves teams hours of manual documentation work, directly feeding into the Round 3 documentation and viva judging criteria.
